CustomField.description: Optional. Length in months of each renewal period when the contract states it. Renewal Date rolls Auto-Renewal and Evergreen contracts forward in this many months; when blank, 12 months (since 2026-09-23; the original default of the initial term rolled multi-year contracts 3+ years out). Added Sep 2026.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Months in each renewal period, if the contract states it (36 for a three-year renewal). Leave blank for 12 months.
CustomField.label: Renewal Term (Months)
